transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve been having a hard time with how I see myself at work. I keep thinking I’m not really senior material, like I somehow fooled people into thinking I can handle more than I actually can. It’s been getting to me.
Did this start after a specific change or event at work?
Yeah… I think so. It got noticeable about a month ago, after they asked me to cover the senior analyst duties. Since then it’s been kind of up and down.
When you're feeling this way, is it mainly about the senior analyst duties?
Mostly, yeah. It’s this feeling that I’m not really cut out for the senior analyst stuff… like I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I could handle it.
Outside of work, do you also find yourself worrying a lot about other parts of your life?
Not really… I mean, not that I’ve noticed. It’s mostly been tied to work.
Has this been making it harder for you to do your work?

A little, yeah. I’m still getting to work and doing what I have to, but I keep checking and rechecking things more than usual. And I’ve kind of pulled back from people outside work too… I don’t really trust my mood or my judgment lately.
Do your reactions to taking on the senior analyst duties feel stronger than you would expect for that situation?
I’m not sure. Maybe a bit stronger than it should be… but it also feels pretty tied to the job, so I don’t really know how to judge that.
When this comes up at work, do you get physically anxious?
I don’t know… not really that I’ve noticed. Maybe I get a little tense, but I wouldn’t say it’s a big physical thing.
Has this been causing you a lot of distress?
Yeah… I guess so. It’s mostly that I keep beating myself up, like I’m not actually senior material and I somehow fooled people into thinking I can handle more than I really can.
If the senior analyst duties were taken away tomorrow, do you think these feelings would mostly go away?
I don’t know. Maybe some of it would, yeah… but I’m not totally sure it would just disappear.
Do these feelings seem stronger than most people would have in response to taking on those senior analyst duties?

Yeah… probably. I mean, I know it’s normal to be nervous with more responsibility, but this feels like I keep turning it into “I don’t belong here” or “I tricked everyone,” which… seems heavier than it should be.
Has this been interfering with your life outside of just feeling upset?

A little, yeah. I’m still getting to work and doing what I need to, but I’m checking myself over and over more than usual. And I’ve kind of pulled back from friends and family… I just don’t really trust my mood or my judgment lately.
Do you feel emotionally exhausted by your work?
Yeah… I guess I do. By the time I get home, even little stuff like checking the mail or loading the dishwasher feels like it takes more out of me than it should.
When these worries about work start, do they feel hard to control?
I’m not totally sure. Sometimes it feels like once it starts, it kind of keeps going for a while… but I don’t know if I’d say I can’t control it. It’s just hard to shake off.
Did these feelings start only after you were asked to cover the senior analyst duties?
Yeah… pretty much. The noticeable ups and downs started about a month ago, after they asked me to cover those senior analyst duties.
If you were no longer covering the senior analyst duties, would these feelings mostly go away?
I don’t think they’d totally go away. The work stuff made it more obvious, but… looking back, those low, guilty stretches have been coming and going for maybe eleven months.
During those low stretches, do you lose interest or enjoyment in things you usually like to do?
Yeah… somewhat. Stuff I normally like, like grilling on the weekend or going fishing… even putting on a record, I just kind of leave it alone lately. Doesn’t feel like I care much.
During those low stretches, do you actually feel down or depressed?
Yeah… I guess I do. Most days lately there’s just this heavy, low feeling. Like I’m getting through work and going home, but everything feels kind of… dulled out.
Has that heavy, low feeling been present most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Yeah… most days lately. It’s kind of just there through the day, that heavy feeling, like I’m going from work to home with everything turned down.
Have you noticed your sleep has changed lately?
Yeah… it’s been off. I either wake up way too early thinking about client tickets and can’t get back to sleep, or I sleep enough but still feel worn out.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?
Yeah… a bit. I’m not really eating much some evenings, just a few bites or I skip supper. My belt’s been a little looser, I guess, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
